name: BEE Hotel SPS (obsolete)
description: Deprecated store-wide price slider for a Bee Hotel Commerce store; superseded by the price alterators.
project_description: BEE Hotel SPS is a deprecated Bee Hotel submodule that added a global (store-wide) price slider to a Commerce store. An admin sets a percentage on a field_price_slider field on the store, and ApplyPriceSlider adjusts the base price by that percentage. It has been superseded by the beehotel_pricealterator GlobalSlider alterator and is marked lifecycle: deprecated.
